rules: Owned character, equipment, NPC, trade, bank, and merchant locations normalize location identity to the already-authoritative owner identity.
Room- and corpse-held items clear stale owner identity because those locations are authoritative non-owned states.
Equipment records missing a slot recover to carried owner inventory; no slot is guessed.
Non-equipment records with stale slots clear the slot and retain provenance.
Any state still invalid after these narrow repairs is rejected and not persisted.
safe_fallback: Fail closed when no authoritative owner or destination can be established.
native_dependency: Exact native corruption-repair behavior remains unresolved for the final native pass.
